metric_definitions.unavailable_methods: Methods unavailable under the selected implementation protocol are not executed: fit_pass, errors, knot count and method time stay null. They are excluded from executed pass-rate denominators and counted separately from actual numerical failures.
metric_definitions.mse: mean_i ||C(t_i)-Q_i||^2 on normalized input points; no square root
metric_definitions.max_squared_error: max_i ||C(t_i)-Q_i||^2 on normalized input points; no square root
metric_definitions.reference_mse: mean squared Euclidean residual on normalized original reference points; parameters mapped from the original arc-length grid to predicted input parameters
metric_definitions.reference_max_squared_error: maximum squared Euclidean residual on the same mapped original reference points; no square root
metric_definitions.mse_max: largest per-curve input MSE among successful finite fits, not a within-curve maximum residual
metric_definitions.reference_mse_max: largest per-curve original-reference MSE among successful finite fits
metric_definitions.peak_aggregation: max_squared_error_mean/p95/max summarize per-curve peak squared residuals; reference_max_squared_error_* uses original reference points
metric_definitions.missing_values: Unavailable historical peak residuals remain null/N/A, never zero. Peak mean/p95/max remain null unless every successful eligible fit has that metric. Peak valid_count counts successful finite measurements; missing_count counts successful eligible fits without that metric. Failed fits remain in pass-rate denominators.
metric_definitions.scope: Discrete corresponding-point residuals in normalized coordinates, not Hausdorff distance or a certified continuous-curve maximum; all metric evaluation is excluded from successful method timing
metric_definitions.pass_criterion: Existing MSE tolerance only; maximum squared error is an additional diagnostic and does not change pass/fail
